parsed.scene_description: A high-ceilinged interior with large windows on the left showing bright outdoor light. A tall spiral bookshelf stands centrally near a round table where two people sit. Other tables and chairs are arranged along the window wall. The floor is reflective. In the background, more shelving units and stairs are visible.

objects.label: spiral bookshelf
objects.observation: Tall cylindrical structure with multiple horizontal shelves containing books. Each shelf level has a continuous ring of LED lighting. The base is metallic and reflective. Positioned centrally in the room.

objects.label: round table
objects.observation: Low circular wooden table situated near the spiral bookshelf. Two people are seated at it with laptops and bags placed on or beside it.

objects.label: chairs
objects.observation: Multiple chairs with metal frames and blue seats. Some are tucked under tables near the window; others are positioned around the central table.

objects.label: window wall
objects.observation: Large glass panels framed by dark vertical mullions. Bright daylight illuminates the scene from outside. Trees are faintly visible through the glass.

objects.label: background shelving
objects.observation: Multiple rows of horizontal shelves filled with books located in the background on the right side. Stairs leading upward are partially visible.
